projects.title: Conviction
projects.summary: A real-time risk duel on Solana — two teams stake token baskets behind sealed threshold bands; whoever breaks out first auto-folds and the survivor mints the round's governance token.
projects.description: Built on MagicBlock Permissioned Ephemeral Rollups with a 25-instruction Anchor program, 25-SPL curated universe, and Birdeye live prices (with seed-walk fallback). 10-route Next.js frontend with shadcn, Framer Motion, and Zustand. Submitted for MagicBlock Blitz v8.

cover.alt: Screenshot of the deployed Conviction app — two opposing scoreboards with red and green threshold lines meeting at a tokenised chart.

projects.title: Centralized Exchange
projects.summary: A full centralised exchange on Solana devnet — stateless actix-web REST API, stateful order-book matching engine, and a settler worker, all bridged via Redis Streams.
projects.description: Matching engine supports limit, market (IOC), stop, and stop-limit orders with FIFO price-time priority, partial fills, and self-match prevention. Anchor program handles deposit, withdraw, and settle_fill. Next.js 14 frontend with Phantom wallet, TradingView charts via lightweight-charts, and TanStack Query. Program ID: DNhvifJ6mcgVRRA4xaNKH82tjoHseN3GQKiLi8R7i6HY.
stack: Rust (actix-web, redis, tokio, ed25519-dalek, jsonwebtoken, rust_decimal)

cover.alt: Screenshot of the Centralized Exchange trading interface — order book, chart, and trade form.

projects.title: Rust Web Server
projects.summary: A multithreaded HTTP/1.1 server in pure Rust stdlib — custom reusable ThreadPool, real HTTP parser, function-pointer router, graceful shutdown.
projects.description: Replaces thread-per-request with a custom reusable ThreadPool. Real HTTP/1.1 parser, function-pointer router, generic handlers, named workers, graceful shutdown signal handling. Routes /, /sleep, /health, plus 404 / 405. Built from The Rust Book chapter 20 and extended — no third-party deps.

cover.alt: An HTTP request arrow looping through a pool of worker threads, rendered on a black schematic.
